note: Where the strange things come from. Cyberpunk RED prints no supply chain; this is ours, and it is read off things the engine already recorded, never off prose. A place that GAINED one of the `salvage` flags (place_changed rows) and a job that settled at a place (job_settled receipts) each send stuff onto the street for `windowDays`: shops in that place's district, and every shop that leans in for finds (the fences) wherever it is, turn up one more find a week for each, up to `maxLean`, and each such find carries where it came from. A find off a job that moved standing with an organisation is HOT: one step down the price ladder, and buying it means that organisation hears who did (`seen`, against them). Nothing here is ever stored on the item but its provenance key, and that key is checked against the atlas and the factions every time it is read.

salvage.raided: Pulled out of {place} after the raid.
salvage.shut: Cleared out of {place} when it shut.
salvage.power_out: Walked out of {place} while the power was down.
salvage.locked_down: Smuggled out of {place} during the lockdown.

hot: Came off the job at {place}. {faction} will want it back, and will hear who bought it.
resaleNote: A find you sell stays on that seller's shelf for this many stock weeks, at its full price, unless you buy it back first. Commodity sales vanish into the stock.

sell.note: What a seller pays: half the printed price, divided by their markup (a fixer's cut comes out of yours too). Only kinds they deal in, plus any find at a shop that leans in for finds. Ammunition and chrome are not bought back.
